about.heading: About me
about.lead: I'm a full-stack software engineer working mostly with TypeScript, Node.js and C#/.NET. Before I write code, I want to understand the problem behind it, so working closely with the team and the client is important to me.
body: On the frontend, I like working with Angular best. I care about a clean, modular structure, use server-side rendering when needed, and build UIs that work on any device and are accessible. On the backend, I build REST APIs with NestJS or .NET. Most of them run as microservices on Azure, in Docker containers.

I want software to still be understandable and secure a few years from now. So I cover new features with unit and integration tests, document important architecture decisions as ADRs, and plan for security from the start. OpenTelemetry gives me a clear view across service boundaries, so I can spot anomalies before they turn into real problems.

Agentic software engineering has completely changed software engineering. AI agents now write, test and refactor code largely on their own. I use them deliberately where they save me the most work. But what gets built, and how, is still up to me.

entries.title: Solution Expert · Full-Stack Software Engineer
entries.text: Full-stack development with Angular, Next.js, NestJS and .NET in an Azure microservice architecture. I choose technologies by what the requirements need rather than by habit, and security and compliance are part of the architecture from the start. Also client consulting in close alignment with architects and product owners.

entries.title: Web Developer
entries.text: Evolving the in-house CMS and building responsive client websites with TYPO3, with a focus on accessibility and reusable web components in TypeScript. Also advising public-sector clients from concept to launch.

projects.title: E-Commerce Shop · Multi-Vendor & Multi-Market
projects.text: Full-stack development of a shop for eyewear products including prescription data, connected to microservices, Salesforce and OneTrust. Built with Angular, NestJS, BullMQ, PostgreSQL and TypeORM.

projects.title: Agent-Based Product Recommendations
projects.text: Frontend of an application for personalized product recommendations, plus changes to the API endpoints in the Python backend. Built with Angular, TypeScript and Python.

projects.title: Production Solution Management Portal
projects.text: Portal for production status, templates and configurations. Server-side rendered frontend and API contracts with the .NET backend. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and .NET.

projects.title: Identity Management Portal
projects.text: Portal for managing user identities and role-based access rights. Built with Next.js, .NET and OAuth/OIDC.

projects.title: Location Access Management
projects.text: System for requesting access to company sites. Built with Angular and .NET.
